extracted.intended_audience: deal‑savvy streamers and consumers looking to get HBO Max cheaply or for free
extracted.subtask_description: A consumer-facing how-to guide that explains promotions, bundles, and workarounds to obtain HBO Max for free or at a reduced cost, including specific carrier and bundle offers and step-by-step claiming instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: HBO Max direct free trial availability
rubrics_metrics.description: The streaming service is notorious for offering no free trial period directly through its site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because HBO Max does not typically offer a free trial directly, look for partner promotions or workarounds (carriers, MVPDs, or bundle offers) to obtain a trial or free months.

rubrics_metrics.name: DirecTV 3-month HBO Max promotion
rubrics_metrics.description: Customers who sign up for either DirecTV’s Entertainment, Choice or Ultimate streaming package can get three months of HBO Max, Paramount+ Premium, STARZ, Cinemax and MGM+ included at no cost (valued at $175).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To claim: select your preferred signature package, then opt to add HBO Max when picking add-ons — the three months will be included automatically. Note the included additional premium services and the stated value.

rubrics_metrics.name: DirecTV five-day free trial
rubrics_metrics.description: DirecTV offers a five-day free trial for any of its plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use DirecTV’s five-day free trial to evaluate the service and to combine with the three-month HBO Max promotion; be aware of the trial length when planning cancellations.

rubrics_metrics.name: HBO Max + Disney+ + Hulu bundle pricing
rubrics_metrics.description: The HBO Max, Disney+ and Hulu bundle is available for $19.99 per month, versus $34.97 if purchased separately (Disney+ and Hulu each start at $11.99), representing a 43% savings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare the bundle price to individual subscription costs to determine savings; the bundle can be substantially cheaper than subscribing to services separately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ad-free bundle upgrade benefits and pricing
rubrics_metrics.description: Upgrade to the ad-free bundle for $32.99 monthly to get offline downloading access to shows and your watchlist, a savings of 41% compared to signing up individually.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose the ad-free tier if offline downloads and an ad-free experience are important; weigh the higher bundle cost against the convenience/features it provides.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verizon carrier perk for HBO Max and Netflix
rubrics_metrics.description: Verizon offers a perk that lets customers get both HBO Max and Netflix for just $10 per month, cheaper than HBO Max alone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To claim this perk, sign up for an eligible Verizon Unlimited plan; verify current Verizon terms and eligibility before subscribing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standalone HBO Max pricing reference
rubrics_metrics.description: HBO Max on its own starts at $10.99 per month.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the standalone price as a baseline when comparing bundles, carrier perks, and promotions to decide whether a deal actually saves money for your viewing needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check renewal and cancellation terms
rubrics_metrics.description: After promotional periods (e.g., DirecTV’s three months), premium add-ons will renew monthly at the then-prevailing rate unless cancelled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware of automatic renewal policies for any promotion; cancel before the end of the promotional period if you do not want to continue paying full price.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to claim partner promotions (step-by-step guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: When claiming partner offers, you typically must select a qualifying package and explicitly add HBO Max in the add-ons flow to receive the promotion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the provider’s signup flow carefully (select signature package → choose add-ons → confirm HBO Max inclusion). Confirm the promotional period, included services, and that the discount appears before completing signup.
